clue.text: Support that could aid constitutional progress

definitions.text: Support that could aid constitutional progress

parts.words: Support that could aid constitutional progress
parts.note: a constitutional is a health-giving stroll, so this is a prop that helps someone on their daily walk

explanation.surface: Something that might help a reform bill through Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Constitutional' suggests politics and a nation's constitution, but here it is the old word for a stroll taken for one's health.
explanation.definitionFit: A cane carried while out strolling supports the walker as they go.

clue.text: Archaeologist's horse

definitions.meaning: Sir Mortimer ... was a British excavator
a horse harnessed nearest the wheels of a carriage

explanation.definitionFit: Mortimer Wheeler was a famous excavator, and a wheel horse is the one hitched next to the wheels.

clue.text: Articles in van

definitions.meaning: leading articles, the editorials in a newspaper
those in the van, the vanguard, are at the front

explanation.definitionFit: Editorials are called leading articles, and those in the vanguard head the rest.

clue.text: Is no female detailed to move here?

indicators.note: the letters are set moving into a new order
de-tailed, the last letter is cut off

explanation.surface: A place with no women, where nobody wants to relocate?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detailed' trims FEMALE to FEMAL; 'to move' rearranges ISNOFEMAL. 'Here' points to a place, famous for motorcycle racing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Crown dependency in the Irish Sea is the place the clue points to.

clue.text: County girl announced tea

indicators.note: spoken, so the letter is the one that sounds like the drink

parts.note: the drink sounds like the letter T

explanation.surface: A local girl calling out that tea is ready.
explanation.walkthrough: GWENT is a former Welsh county.
explanation.definitionFit: Gwent was an administrative region of south-east Wales.

clue.text: Neater character sketched by Boz

definitions.meaning: Boz was Dickens's pen name, as in Sketches by Boz

explanation.definitionFit: Something trimmer is tidier, and Trimmer is a figure in Dickens's early Sketches by Boz.

clue.text: Gossip over water in French residence

indicators.note: in a down answer, the first piece sits above the second

explanation.surface: Chattering by the water at a house in France.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand country house or castle in France is a residence.

clue.text: Press crew the country needed

parts.note: a four is a rowing crew

explanation.surface: A newspaper needing a team for the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: The newspapers are traditionally called the estate that follows clergy, lords and commons.

clue.text: Leaving nothing uncovered, in general

definitions.meaning: a garment worn over everything else, covering the whole body
taken as a whole, all things considered

explanation.definitionFit: A boiler suit covers the wearer completely, and the adverb means taking everything together.

clue.text: Final judgment — record it with legal writer, initially

parts.note: A. P. Herbert, author of the comic Misleading Cases, signed himself by his initials

explanation.surface: A last verdict on a case, logged along with a lawyer's initials.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Initially' looks like it takes first letters of words, but it means the writer's initials: APH for Sir Alan Patrick Herbert, humorist and campaigner on legal matters.
explanation.definitionFit: An inscription on a tomb is the last word passed on someone's life.

clue.text: Intimate communication to put in similar cards

indicators.note: the short word goes between the two copies
similar cards means a matching pair of the same card, so one card is taken twice

parts.note: a heart is a playing card of that suit

explanation.surface: A loving message tucked inside matching greeting cards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Similar' doubles the card; 'put in' places the short word between the pair. The cards are the suit of hearts in a deck.
explanation.definitionFit: A frank, personal talk is a close and private exchange.

clue.text: Outstanding work I put into production of "Oliver"

indicators.note: the letter is placed inside the rearranged letters
a production reworks the title, so the letters of Oliver are rearranged

explanation.surface: A performer's star turn in a staging of the musical Oliver!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Production of' makes RLIEVO from OLIVER; 'put into' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Relief sculpture stands out from its background, so it is work that literally projects.

clue.text: Painter's medium or moderate article

parts.note: to temper is to moderate or soften

explanation.surface: Either a paint or a calm piece of writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Egg-based paint is a medium, the substance pigment is mixed in.

clue.text: Divine creature in chorus-line

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the hyphenated word chorus-line

explanation.surface: A goddess spotted among the dancers of a chorus line.
explanation.definitionFit: The falcon-headed Egyptian sky god is a divine being.

clue.text: Important case in which contract may be finalized

definitions.text: in which contract may be finalized

parts.note: a suit is a case brought in a law court

explanation.surface: A significant lawsuit in which a business deal could be settled.
explanation.walkthrough: The contract is not a legal one but a bridge contract: game is most often bid and made in spades or hearts.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge, spades and hearts score most and are where a game contract is often played.

clue.text: Brideshead's the place for this young lover to excel

explanation.surface: Brideshead Revisited as the setting for a young romance to triumph.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brideshead' evokes Waugh's novel, but read as bride's head it is where this close-fitting cap is worn.
explanation.definitionFit: A small round mesh cap is worn on a bride's head with her veil.

clue.text: Influential round if it's one of the last matches

definitions.text: Influential round if it's one of the last matches

parts.words: Influential round if it's one of the last matches
parts.note: a stage of a knockout contest that decides who reaches the final, one of the last few games

explanation.surface: A decisive round late in a tournament.
explanation.definitionFit: The penultimate knockout stage is a round that settles who plays in the final.

clue.text: Swallow one cocktail

parts.note: a martin is a bird of the swallow family
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Gulping down a single drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swallow' looks like a verb for drinking; it is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Gin and vermouth make a classic mixed drink.

clue.text: Gave up because failed

parts.note: went means failed, as in the bulb went

explanation.surface: Someone quitting because they had failed.
explanation.definitionFit: To do without something is to renounce it.

clue.text: Tree about to add another ring

indicators.note: a second copy of the same short word is added to the first

explanation.surface: A tree about to add another growth ring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To add another' asks for CA twice; then O is added.
explanation.definitionFit: The cocoa tree is the tropical plant whose seeds give chocolate.

clue.text: Manager of bank till discharge

definitions.meaning: the bank clerk in charge of the cash
to dismiss an officer from the forces in disgrace

explanation.definitionFit: A bank teller handles the cash drawer, and the verb means to dismiss from military service.

clue.text: Drink tea with Joy or Felicity, endlessly

explanation.surface: Having tea with two friends called Joy and Felicity.
explanation.walkthrough: Joy and Felicity look like names; they are synonyms for BLISS, cut to BLIS by 'endlessly'.
explanation.definitionFit: A dry white Burgundy wine is something to sip.

clue.text: Flying Squad?

parts.note: read literally, a squad or team that flies

explanation.surface: Scotland Yard's Flying Squad of detectives.
explanation.walkthrough: The Flying Squad is a London police unit; read literally, it is a team in an aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: The staff who operate an aeroplane are a team who work aloft.

clue.text: Wine or ale for the first person

definitions.text: Wine or ale for the first person

parts.words: Wine or ale for the first person
parts.note: Adam, the first man, could only drink what the phrases Adam's ale and Adam's wine describe

explanation.surface: Choosing a drink for whoever comes first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The first person' looks like grammar (I, me) but is Adam.
explanation.definitionFit: Adam's ale is a jocular name for plain drinking liquid from the tap.

clue.text: These novel diamonds may be cut with ease

indicators.note: the letters may be formed into something else, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Jewels from a story that can be cut with no trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: The Eustace Diamonds is a Trollope novel; 'novel' is the noun, not 'new'.
explanation.definitionFit: Trollope's novel The Eustace Diamonds names the family who own the jewels.

clue.text: Met nine or ten men I recollected as famous

indicators.note: collected again into a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Meeting a handful of celebrated people one remembers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Met nine' is also an anagram of the answer: the setter offers two fodders joined by 'or', and 'recollected' rearranges either.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone eminent is distinguished and widely known.

clue.text: Poet lacking capital more affected by freeze

indicators.note: the capital letter, the first, is dropped

parts.note: Friedrich Schiller was a German poet

explanation.surface: A poet without money suffering more in the cold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' looks like money but means the first letter, S of SCHILLER.
explanation.definitionFit: Chillier, more frozen, means more affected by cold.

clue.text: Physical pastimes resumed after fall

parts.note: fall is the American autumn, after which skiing and skating come back; a fall also means a tumble

explanation.surface: Athletes getting back to sport after a tumble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fall' suggests a tumble, but it is the season of autumn, followed by the snow season.
explanation.definitionFit: Skiing and skating are games played in the cold season after autumn.
